channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Aliados notam uma mudança em Michelle no caso da prisão de Bolsonaro
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro's house arrest, granted by Alexandre de Moraes for health reasons, ends this Thursday, with allies expecting its continuation. However, the political articulation that originally secured the measure — led by Michelle Bolsonaro and the PL — is not being repeated in the renewal request, now handled solely by his lawyers. Michelle has distanced herself from party activities after Flávio Bolsonaro was named the family's presidential candidate, focusing on her husband's health and family matters.

item.title: Lula ao inaugurar obra no RJ: "País não pode ser rico e estado pobre"
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva inaugurated a section of the Serra das Araras restructuring project on the Presidente Dutra Highway in Rio de Janeiro, arguing that the country cannot be rich while states and cities remain poor. He emphasized that Workers’ Party governments have invested the most in infrastructure across states and said the project will bring more development, companies, and quality jobs to the region. The inaugurated segment covers 8 kilometers in each direction of the 16-kilometer project, with an estimated cost of R$ 1.5 billion.

item.title: Governo destina R$ 2 bi para FGI e amplia acesso a crédito
item.description: The federal government published Provisional Measure No. 1.371/2026, clarifying the allocation of R$ 2 billion in extraordinary credit to the Investment Guaranty Fund (FGI), linked to the Emergency Credit Access Program (PEAC-FGI). The measure reinforces a financial protection mechanism to incentivize banks to lend to Brazilian companies, without changing the previously authorized amount from MP No. 1.354/2026.

item.title: Neymar x Escócia: craque vai usar caneleira de R$ 7 mil
item.description: Neymar will wear custom shin guards valued at R$7,000 in the match against Scotland, made by Profix using 3D scanning and customized by artist Thiago Rosinhole. Although he has resumed training with the ball after a calf injury, he is not expected to start, as Raphinha is also injured and three other players are favored for the lineup. Lula’s comment calling Neymar the 'first home office call-up in the world' sparked backlash from right-wing politicians, intensifying Brazil’s toxic political polarization.

item.title: Os cariocas vão torcer para as crias da base dos rivais? O GLOBO foi às ruas conferir
item.description: Rio de Janeiro fans were interviewed about their support for players from rival clubs on the Brazilian national team ahead of the 2026 World Cup. Some advocate for national unity and unconditional support for Brazil regardless of players' club affiliations, while others maintain club loyalties but make exceptions for homegrown talents. The debate highlights the tension between club identity and national sporting patriotism.

item.title: Aliados veem André do Prado mais próximo de Tarcísio do que Derrite na corrida pelo Senado em SP
item.description: Allies of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas state that André do Prado, president of the São Paulo Legislative Assembly, is now closer to the governor than Guilherme Derrite in the Senate race. This is based on André’s increased presence in events with Tarcísio and São Paulo Mayor Ricardo Nunes, along with public praise from the governor, who called him an 'aggregator' and the most-voted senatorial candidate in SP. Political scientist Elias Tavares notes that Tarcísio’s strong approval ratings could be pivotal for André’s campaign.

item.title: Como Tarcísio explica deixar o consignado com o banco de Edir Macedo?
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas authorized Banco Digimais, controlled by Bishop Edir Macedo of the Universal Church, to offer payroll loans to military police in September 2023, despite the bank already being under Federal Police investigation for fraud and in poor financial health. The move drew criticism over potential conflicts of interest, given the ties between Tarcísio’s party, the Republicans, and the religious group led by Macedo.

item.title: ‘Nós não fazemos coisa para rico’, diz Lula em inauguração da Nova Serra das Araras
item.description: President Lula inaugurated four kilometers of the uphill track of the new Serra das Araras, emphasizing that the works, part of the New PAC, aim to reduce tolls and benefit the population with lower transportation costs. Rio de Janeiro's acting governor, Ricardo Couto, highlighted the project's economic and mobility impact, linking it to the Propag program and expressing gratitude to the federal government. The event took place in Paracambi on the Presidente Dutra Highway, with full completion expected by March 2027.

item.title: Jaques Wagner já deveria ter entregue o cargo, diz Tebet
item.description: Simone Tebet (PSB) stated that Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) should have already stepped down as government leader in the Senate due to his involvement in the 9th phase of Operation Compliance Zero, linked to Banco Master, to avoid exposing the government. She also advocated for a CPI or CPMI to investigate the case, stressing that Congress must ensure transparency to the public. Wagner denies the allegations and claims President Lula intends to keep him in office, having met with PT allies in Bahia to assess his political position.

item.title: Com agendas no estado, Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro intensificam a decisiva ‘batalha por São Paulo’
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are intensifying their agendas in São Paulo alongside their respective gubernatorial candidates, Fernando Haddad (PT) and Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos). The race for Brazil’s largest electoral college is seen as pivotal for the 2026 presidential election, especially following the withdrawal of other contenders, increasing the likelihood of a first-round decision. Lula will focus on public security and health in Guarulhos and São Paulo, while Flávio will join Tarcísio in agribusiness and right-wing events in Presidente Prudente.

item.title: Os recados indiretos de Michelle Bolsonaro
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro has avoided publicly commenting on the crises involving her stepchildren, including Flávio Bolsonaro's proximity to banker Daniel Vorcaro and Eduardo Bolsonaro's conviction for coercion in the case that led to Jair Bolsonaro's sentencing for attempted coup. She remains silent despite growing family controversies.

item.title: Indexa: Lula amplia vantagem e chega a 42%; Flávio Bolsonaro tem 31%
item.description: Lula extends his lead to 42% in voting intentions for the 2026 elections, while Flávio Bolsonaro reaches 31%, increasing the gap between them from nine to eleven points. Alternative candidates such as Ronaldo Caiado (5%), Romeu Zema (3%) and Renan Santos (3%) continue to show low support, reflecting the persistent polarization between lulismo and bolsonarism.

item.title: BOMBA!! LULA VAI CAIR!! POLÍCIA FEDERAL ENTREGOU TUDO!!
item.description: The presented content is a sensationalist video with a misleading title that provides no substantive information about Federal Police actions against President Lula. There is no evidence of evidence delivery or concrete legal implications mentioned in the provided text. The material appears to be misinformation designed to generate engagement through unfounded alarmism.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula inaugura obras na Dutra
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva inaugurates on Tuesday (June 23, 2026) the first phase of the new Serra das Araras project on the Presidente Dutra highway in Paracambi (RJ). The phase includes 4 km of uphill lane with 4 lanes, shoulders, lighting, and 8 viaducts, backed by R$1.5 billion in investment and 70% completion. The full project plans for 8 lanes, 24 viadutos, and escape ramps in a corridor used by 390,000 monthly vehicles, 36% of which are freight.

item.title: Como os eleitores avaliam o governo Lula em cada área, a quase 3 meses da eleição
item.description: The Ipsos-Ipec poll shows Lula's government with 44% approval and 50% disapproval, with 38% rating it as poor or terrible and 32% as good or excellent. Education is the best-rated area, while economic issues like inflation and public spending control are the worst. Ratings remain stable compared to the March 2026 survey.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro se inscreve para falar em audiência nos EUA antes de decisão final sobre tarifaço
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) registered to speak at a USTR public hearing in the U.S. regarding the proposed 25% tariff on Brazilian goods, advocating for its suspension and defending the Pix payment system while criticizing the STF. The hearing is scheduled for July 6, with a final decision expected by July 15. A Genial/Quaest poll reveals 47% associate the tariff with Flávio Bolsonaro as having requested it, while 35% believe he asked Trump to avoid tariffs on Brazilian products.

item.title: Portugal x Uzbequistão na Copa: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Portugal and Uzbekistan will face off on Tuesday, June 23, at 2:00 p.m. Brasília time, in the second matchday of Group K of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, held at Houston Stadium, USA. The match will be exclusively broadcast on CazéTV. Portugal, which drew its opener against the Democratic Republic of Congo, needs a win to recover in the group, while Uzbekistan, making its World Cup debut, lost to Colombia in its first match.

item.title: Flávio pede para falar em audiência sobre tarifaço nos EUA
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a pre-candidate for the Brazilian presidency, requested to speak at a public hearing by the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) regarding a proposed 25% tariff on Brazilian imports. His registration was submitted on the final deadline day, Monday, the 22nd. The proposed tariffs could significantly affect Brazil's economy, particularly its export-oriented sectors.

item.title: Distante de Flávio, Michelle não conta com nova articulação do PL pela prisão domiciliar de Bolsonaro
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro is acting alone to prevent Jair Bolsonaro from leaving house arrest and returning to the Papuda penitentiary, without coordination from the PL or allies for a meeting with Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The party’s current strategy relies on strengthening her relationship with the magistrate, while lawyers seek to extend the benefit. Michelle’s distancing from the PL’s political wing followed Flávio Bolsonaro’s official nomination as presidential candidate.

item.title: Escândalo e luta interna abalam ‘máquina’ eleitoral do PT na Bahia
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner, Lula’s leader in the Senate and a Bahia senatorial candidate, became embroiled in the Master Bank scandal, prompting internal PT pressure for his resignation from Senate leadership despite his strong electoral record in the state. The PT leadership chose self-criticism over defending allies, unlike other parties, revealing an internal power struggle for post-Lula influence. The scandal threatens the PT’s electoral machine in Bahia, which delivered the bulk of Lula’s 2022 victory.

item.title: TSE ainda não tem data para analisar eleição suplementar de Roraima
item.description: Arthur Henrique, the top vote-getter in Roraima’s supplementary gubernatorial election with 61% of the votes, had his candidacy blocked by the Roraima Electoral Court (TRE-RR) for failing to meet the six-month disassociation requirement from his mayoral post, despite following a local rule allowing candidacy 24 hours after party conventions. He appealed to the TSE, where ministers preliminarily voted 4-0 in favor of validating the 24-hour rule, but the judgment was paused due to a request for view. The TSE has not yet set a date to a request for vista. Although no date has been set for the TSE’s analysis, Electoral Justice sources indicate a decision is expected within three weeks, ahead of the July 13 diploma ceremony.

item.title: Dívida com a União: quanto o Rio economiza ao aderir ao Propag?
item.description: Rio de Janeiro joined the Full Payment of States' Debts Program (Propag), reducing its debt to the Union from R$210 billion to R$168.5 billion with zero annual interest. The measure will generate savings of R$6.2 billion in 2026 and R$12.3 billion in 2027, to be invested in professional education, infrastructure, security and social areas. The state also committed to allocating 1% of the outstanding debt balance to the Federative Equalization Fund (FEF).

item.title: Ao deixar Dark Horse com Mendonça, Fachin dribla dilema de Moraes
item.description: Supreme Court President Edson Fachin can choose whether the Dark Horse case stays with André Mendonça or Alexandre de Moraes, opting either for Mendonça’s technical precedence (as rapporteur of the Banco Master investigation) or raising suspicion against Moraes due to his wife’s R$129 million contract with the bank. The PGR supports transferring the case to Mendonça, allowing Fachin to avoid Moraes’ ethical dilemma, especially since Flávio Bolsonaro’s defense requested both options.

item.title: Bolsa Família: Zema diz que só exigirá estudo de homens, e não de mulheres
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and presidential pré-candidate for Novo, stated that if elected, he would require only male beneficiaries of Bolsa Família to complete basic education, arguing that women 'have other responsibilities at home'. He also proposed a R$ 5,000 reward for beneficiaries who leave the program. The proposal was made at a CNI event in Brasília, where Zema advocated for an 'institutional shock' to combat corruption and public spending.

item.title: Nova Serra das Araras começa a deixar para trás curvas históricas; vídeo mostra trecho de 4km a ser liberado quinta
item.description: A 4 km stretch of the new uphill lane of Serra das Araras on BR-116 will be opened to traffic on Thursday (25), following an inauguration ceremony with President Lula on Tuesday (23). The project features four lanes, LED lighting, eight viaducts, and eliminates seven critical curves, improving flow for about 13,000 vehicles daily. Full completion of the downhill lane is expected by Q1 2027.

item.title: Datafolha: 36% dos brasileiros acreditam que economia vai melhorar nos próximos meses; pessimismo cai de 35% para 26%
item.description: Brazilians' economic expectations improved, with 36% expecting improvement in the coming months (up from 30% in March) and those expecting worsening falling from 35% to 26%. Personal financial outlook remains stable, with 51% expecting improvement and 12% expecting decline. Optimism is strongest among Lula supporters (52%), low-income and less-educated groups, while pessimism is highest among Flávio Bolsonaro supporters (45%), high-income and highly educated groups.

item.title: Mendonça rechaça tese de favorecimento a Flávio e vê 'fogo-amigo' no STF
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça rejected claims that his rulings in the Master case favor Flávio Bolsonaro, stating that the lack of search and seizure operations against the PL senator reflects procedural differences, not bias. He described criticism as 'friendly fire,' suggesting it comes from government allies who expected harsher measures against Jaques Wagner. Mendonça defended the legitimacy of his role as rapporteur, stressing adherence to the law and case files.

item.title: Lula abre saco de bondades no Rio, estado dominado pelos Bolsonaros
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva held a ceremony in Rio de Janeiro to sign the state's adhesion to the Full Payment of States' Debts Program (Propag), highlighting Rio as the only state to receive such a pompous event, despite 22 of the 27 Brazilian states having already joined the program. The choice of Rio, a state historically dominated by Bolsonarist influence, was not random and carries strong political symbolism.

item.title: Crítica de Lula a Neymar gera mais interesse no Google do que atuação do jogador na Copa
item.description: President Lula's criticism of Neymar, calling him the 'first home office player in the world,' generated more Google search interest than the player's potential World Cup call-up. The remark was seized upon by the opposition, including Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, who wore a Brazil jersey in response. Neymar, who supported Bolsonaro in 2022, is recovering from an injury and is set to debut in the World Cup against Scotland on June 24.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro cogita se mudar para SP até as eleições por logística e proximidade com Tarcísio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) is considering relocating to São Paulo ahead of the 2026 elections for strategic reasons, aiming to tap into the country’s largest electoral college, leverage logistical advantages between the South, Rio de Janeiro, and Minas Gerais, and strengthen ties with Governor Tarcísio de Freitas’ campaign. Part of his team, including advertisers Alexandre Oltramari and Eduardo Fischer, has already moved to the capital to consolidate Bolsonarist support in the state, where his father won in 2022.

item.title: Em resposta a Gilmar, Zema diz que ministros “botam milhões no bolso”
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and 2026 presidential pre-candidate, accused Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes of ‘pocketing millions’ through contracts, claiming impeachment requests against ministers are justified by alleged corruption. Zema also stated the Senate needs greater renewal in 2026 and that, by 2027, ‘the untouchables’ will begin to fall, promoting his AI-generated video series ‘The Untouchables’ to push for accountability.

item.title: MPE contesta decisão de Nunes sobre pesquisa da Atlas
item.description: The Electoral Public Ministry challenged the decision of Minister Nunes Marques of the TSE, which suspended the disclosure of an AtlasIntel poll on the impact of the conversation between Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro on voting intentions. The MPE argues that judicial interference in electoral polls must be exceptional and only justified when there is concrete evidence of undue influence on voters' opinion formation, which, according to the ministry, did not occur in this poll. The survey, released on May 19, showed a 5-point drop in voting intention for Flávio Bolsonaro after the audio surfaced in which he asks Vorcaro for money to fund the film 'Dark Horse'.

item.title: Flávio pede para falar em audiência nos EUA sobre tarifas ao Brasil
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) requested to speak at a U.S. public hearing to oppose a proposed 25% tariff on Brazilian goods, arguing it would benefit the current Brazilian government while harming Brazilian exporters, U.S. importers, U.S. consumers, and the Brazilian opposition. He claims to have recently met with Trump, Vance, and Rubio on the issue and seeks 5 minutes to testify at the July 6 hearing, ahead of the July 15 deadline for Trump’s final decision. The tariff stems from a USTR Section 301 investigation into alleged unfair trade practices, including Pix and intellectual property, with exemptions for goods such as meats, coffee, pharmaceuticals, and aircraft.

item.title: Parcela de pessimistas com economia cai de 35% para 26%, diz Datafolha
item.description: The share of Brazilians pessimistic about the economy dropped from 35% to 26% in three and a half months, while optimists rose from 30% to 36%, according to Datafolha. Improved economic sentiment is strongest among less educated, low-income, and Lula supporters, while pessimism remains higher among the more educated, high-income, and Flávio Bolsonaro voters.

item.title: “Jurisprudência Nunes Marques” não deve se manter, diz Gilmar
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes criticized the TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques' decision to suspend the AtlasIntel poll on Flávio Bolsonaro, labeling it 'jurisprudência Nunes Marques' and stating it will not be upheld by the STF, as it violates freedom of expression precedents like ADPF 130. He believes the case will reach the Supreme Court due to disrespect for these precedents, particularly regarding indirect censorship of electoral polls.

item.title: Motta articula com governo aumento do limite do MEI
item.description: Chamber of Deputies President Hugo Motta announced he is negotiating with the federal government to increase the MEI revenue cap from R$81,000 to R$130,000 annually, allowing up to two employees. The proposal, based on PLP 108/2021, is expected to be submitted by the Executive by June 24 for review by a special committee chaired by Any Ortiz with Jorge Goetten as rapporteur. The fiscal impact is estimated at up to R$22.7 billion annually, creating resistance within the economic team despite political support.

item.title: Tarifaço de Trump: governo oscila sobre a melhor estratégia para lidar com os EUA
item.description: The Brazilian government is divided on how to respond to the U.S. tariff threat under the Trump administration, which could impose duties of up to 37.5% on Brazilian exports. While the MDIC advocates for a swift reversal to protect domestic companies, the Foreign Ministry and Treasury prioritize negotiation quality, even if it means delaying talks until after the October Brazilian and November U.S. midterm elections. The lack of a bilateral meeting between Lula and Trump at the G7 has deepened the stalemate, though the government claims to act unanimously in defense of national interest.

item.title: Montadoras tentam barrar volta de isenção de carro elétrico importado que beneficia BYD: decisão será de Lula
item.description: Anfavea is pressuring the federal government to maintain the timetable for reimposing import taxes on electric vehicles, fearing that renewed tax exemptions would favor BYD and destabilize Brazil’s domestic auto sector. The final decision rests with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Vice President Geraldo Alckmin, following a Camex meeting on whether to extend the benefit, which previously applied from August 2025 to January 2026. Automakers cite R$ 140 billion in planned investments through 2030 and oppose additional concessions, while BYD launches its first compact plug-in SUV in Brazil at R$ 149,000.

item.title: Haddad diz lamentar ausência do PSDB nas disputa por governo de SP
item.description: Fernando Haddad expressed regret over the absence of a PSDB candidate in the São Paulo gubernatorial race, saying he had hoped the party would attempt a comeback despite ideological differences. He praised historical PSDB figures like FHC, Mário Covas, and Geraldo Alckmin as ethical references, criticizing the current leadership for being replaced by figures who, he said, do not share values such as truth, democracy, and the fight against violence.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro se inscreve em audiência sobre tarifaço nos EUA
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) has registered to speak at a U.S. International Trade Commission hearing on a proposed 25% tariff on Brazilian imports, recommended by the USTR following an investigation into alleged unfair trade practices. He argues the tariff would benefit the Brazilian government while harming Brazilian exporters, American importers and consumers, and the Brazilian opposition, which he identifies as the main domestic victim. Bolsonaro also opposes any measures targeting Brazil’s Pix payment system, advocating for a negotiated resolution and emphasizing the over-80-year trade partnership between the two countries.

item.title: Mendonça comete “erro crasso” ao saber da delação de Vorcaro, diz Gilmar
item.description: Gilmar Mendes, dean of the Supreme Federal Court, stated that André Mendonça made a "grave error" by speaking with Daniel Vorcaro's lawyer about a selective plea deal, as the law prohibits the rapporteur from participating in such negotiations. Mendes also criticized the use of imprisonment to pressure plea bargains, investigative leaks, and the handling of the Master case, comparing it to Operation Car Wash and stressing the importance of avoiding past mistakes.

item.title: “Vou apresentar todas as reformas em 5 de janeiro”, diz Caiado
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) announced that, if elected, he will send Congress a broad package of reforms on January 5, including tax, labor, administrative, and political changes, with district voting and a single presidential term limit. He criticized the current tax reform for harming liberal professionals, advocated for pension reform due to sustainability concerns, and praised his public security plan based on Goiás’ results, blaming federal leadership for lacking 'moral authority'. Caiado also accused the federal government of undermining Brazil’s industrial competitiveness, citing the 'PT cost' and calling for fiscal balance, lower real interest rates, and a long-term industrial policy.

item.title: Pré-campanha de Flávio teme que Supremo esvazie TSE e o prejudique na disputa com Lula
item.description: Aides and allies of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) fear that recent decisions by the Supreme Federal Court (STF) are disregarding electoral rules and could harm him in the presidential race against Lula (PT). They believe the STF is acting with intent to weaken the TSE’s role and interfere in the 2026 election process.

item.title: PT rechaça ideia de Márcio França de se lançar ao governo de SP
item.description: Leaders of the Workers' Party (PT) rejected former governor Márcio França's (PSB) proposal to run for Governor of São Paulo in 2026, arguing that his candidacy could split the opposition and make it easier for incumbent Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) to secure a runoff. The PT prefers to consolidate a single left-wing candidate to face the right in a potential second round.

item.title: Mortes de PC Farias e Suzana completam 30 anos com processo encerrado e memória em disputa
item.description: The case involving the deaths of PC Farias and Suzana Ramos, which occurred 30 years ago, had its judicial process closed after 22 years, yet remains an enigma in Brazilian politics. PC Farias, treasurer of Fernando Collor's campaign, was a central figure in the corruption scheme that led to the president's impeachment. Despite the case being archived, memory and responsibility for the crimes remain disputed among historians, journalists, and political sectors.

item.title: Projeto do governo sobre aumento do teto do MEI deve ser enviado à Câmara nesta semana, diz Motta
item.description: House Speaker Hugo Motta announced that the Lula government will send a proposal to increase the MEI's annual revenue cap — currently R$81,000 — to the Chamber by this Wednesday (24). The goal is to balance fiscal responsibility with the needs of microentrepreneurs, as competing bills in Congress propose raising the cap to R$140,000 or R$150,000.

item.title: O novo cenário que aproxima Tarcísio da reeleição já no primeiro turno em SP
item.description: The withdrawal of Kim Kataguiri (Missão) and Paulo Serra (PSDB) strengthens Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) as the frontrunner for re-election in São Paulo, with 45.6% of first-round voting intentions according to Paraná Pesquisas, versus 34.1% for Fernando Haddad (PT). Their exit reduces fragmentation in the conservative field, directly benefiting the governor, who is still working to broaden his coalition with nearly ten parties and aims to attract PSDB and Missão. Even in a potential runoff, Tarcísio leads with 51.4% against Haddad’s 37.9%, within the margin of error.

item.title: Caiado diz que anunciará vice antes das convenções de 26 de julho
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) announced he will reveal his vice-presidential running mate before the party's conventions on July 26, speaking at a CNI event in Brasília. He named PSD president Gilberto Kassab as a possible vice-presidential candidate, denied any alliance with Romeu Zema, and highlighted Silvia Abravanel as a 'strong name' for electoral politics—though she clarified her focus remains on running for federal deputy.

item.title: Se o capitalismo reaça tem cloaca, seu nome é Zema: o pombo e o xadrez
item.description: The text criticizes Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and pre-candidate of the Novo party, comparing him to a 'cloaca' of late capitalism due to his reactionary stance, ignorance, and class hatred. Zema advocates revising Bolsa Família to require only men to study to receive the benefit, while exempting women on the grounds of domestic work, revealing sexism and lack of technical basis. Despite being applauded by businessmen who benefited from Lula’s policies, his rhetoric is seen as vulgar, anti-intellectual, and disconnected from Brazil’s low unemployment reality.

item.title: 'Mulheres têm outras atribuições em casa', diz Zema ao anunciar que, se eleito, pretende exigir estudo só dos homens no Bolsa Família
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) stated that, if elected, he would require only male beneficiaries of the Bolsa Família program to complete their studies, arguing that women have 'other responsibilities at home'. He framed the measure as a way to encourage skills development and labor market insertion, while rewarding those who transition to formal employment. The proposal contrasts with current Bolsa Família rules, which mandate school attendance for both boys and girls.
